reason: Owner-approved Overmind reflection, 2026-11-06: a separate model must earn its maintenance beyond existing coverage; an explicit justified no-target outcome is valid.

edits.before: A good target is a promise the code makes, where a break harms users and tests rarely reach the case that breaks it. Choose the strongest such target in the repo, not the one that is easiest to verify.
edits.after:
A good target is a promise the code makes, where a break harms users and tests rarely reach the case that breaks it. Choose the strongest such target in the repo, not the one that is easiest to verify.

If no target justifies a separate model, stop with an explicit no-target outcome. Record the risks considered, the existing coverage, and why a separate model would not earn its maintenance.
